prompt: Single continuous shot. Three ingredients in hard spotlight: a coil of calabresa sausage, two onions, potatoes — one second still. Then motion: potato wedges tossed in oil and coarse salt, roasting to a crackle; calabresa coins hitting a hot pan, edges curling and charring, onion petals collapsing amber into the rendered fat. Money shot: the sizzling calabresa and onions poured over the crisp golden wedges in one cascade, fat glistening, steam bursting backlit. Final beat: hands reaching in from two sides at once. Warm bar-light glow, deep shadows, film grain. Dominant sound: the coin sizzle, then the cascade. No speech, no voice, no narration, no dialogue, no music.
caption: Como prometido: o trio do boteco — batata rústica assada com calabresa acebolada por cima. Cerveja é opcional, disputa é garantida. **Sábado que vem: [A] arroz de ontem, queijo e tomate ou [B] repeteco do trio mais pedido do mês? Comenta A ou B 👇**
